heuristic.applicability: Prefer after the lid has been released and the open hand is clearing toward the peg, especially when observed peg_pose x/y differs from the narrow demonstrated in-box range. It also applies through descent, closure, and lift while peg_pose remains reliable. It can execute the early shared lid-release actions, but that phase is not the invariant it is designed for.

handoff.entry_conditions: The peg is still in the box and is observed. Preferred entry is after the lid fingers have opened and the TCP is no longer coupled to the handle; early entry at index 740 remains supervised for incoming overlap.
handoff.exit_conditions: Exit when closed fingers carry the peg above the box rim, peg_pose and tcp_pose co-move over the two causal frames, and the successor can continue the shared lift/initial turn.
handoff.failure_signatures: TCP does not follow a displaced peg; fingers close with a large peg-relative offset; peg stays near z=0.026 m during lift; peg/TCP relative pose changes abruptly; box-wall contact is suggested by stalled or lateral object motion; IK reports persistent residual or limit contact.
handoff.overlap_role: Preserves all [740,950) incoming lid-release/clearance actions and all [1120,1270) outgoing grasp-consolidation/lift actions. Its main constructed invariant begins once the peg is the active approach reference.
handoff.successor_readiness: reorient_and_stage_peg is ready during the shared lift once fingers are closed, peg z is above the wall top with margin, and recent peg/TCP displacement is consistent.

heuristic.limitations: Peg-relative commands do not make robot reachability, lid/box clearance, contact, or grasp acquisition invariant. A large peg displacement can make the demonstrated approach corridor unreachable or collide with a wall. The demonstrations contain successful pickups only, so this policy is not evidence of regrasp/drop recovery. Early lid release is represented relative to the peg even though lid geometry, not peg displacement, governs that phase; prefer the phase-observable world policy there or the local-increment policy when entry geometry is perturbed.
heuristic.pipeline_implications: This is the displacement specialist. The high-level agent should switch to it after observable lid release/clearance, and may keep it through closed-grasp lift. Route early still-held-lid entries to the phase-observable world policy, and route locally perturbed or off-trajectory TCP entries to the current-TCP increment policy. Do not switch solely on a closed gripper; require object motion evidence for successor readiness.
heuristic.rationale: Observed support: peg starts vary only about 12 mm in x and 11 mm in y across the twelve boundaries. In demo12200 versus demo12208, the index-990 commanded TCP x shifts from -0.6039 to -0.6158 as peg x shifts from -0.6038 to -0.6157, with similar peg-relative descent and lift structure through indices 1080-1240. Mechanism: learn each commanded Cartesian TCP pose as inverse(current observed peg pose) times commanded world TCP pose, encoded as 3-D translation, 6-D rotation, and the native gripper scalar. Decode composes the represented pose with the freshly observed peg pose, then calls the verified IK from freshly measured joints. Causal inputs emphasize TCP-in-peg, lid-in-peg, peg motion, finger state, qpos, and qvel. Thus approach, grasp alignment, and carried lift translate/rotate with the peg by construction; early lid release remains merely learned. Expected benefit is improved peg-displacement transfer, not observed deployment success.
heuristic.statement: Peg-frame Cartesian target prior for displacement-invariant approach, grasp alignment, and lift.

assignment.subgoal: After exposing the box, release and clear the lid if necessary, approach the peg with open fingers, close a stable grasp, and lift the peg above the box walls.

check.checkpoint_selection: last EMA at the declared update budget

conversion_check.description: Compare FK of decoded joints to the demonstrated commanded TCP target in position and rotation, plus gripper scalar. Valid encoded rotations round-trip exactly apart from numerical precision; 6D projection only regularizes degenerate sampled rotations. IK residuals and limit contacts are reported rather than hidden.

contract.cut_relation: Uses every assigned [740,1270) action from all twelve trajectories, preserving incoming [740,950) and outgoing [1120,1270) action-supervised overlaps. Peg framing refines the action coordinates without changing the responsibility or success definition.
contract.output_semantics: Each slot is [peg-frame TCP translation xyz in metres, peg-frame TCP rotation as the first two rotation-matrix columns (6D), native gripper scalar]. The reference peg pose is the observed pose before that action in training and the fresh current observed pose in decoding. Decode projects 6D rotation by safe Gram-Schmidt, left-composes the relative target with the world peg pose, and calls panda_kinematics.solve_ik from freshly measured qpos. Slots are t-1 through t+14 and execution uses slots 1 through 8. Gripper values >=0 open and values <0 close under the common executor.
contract.parameter_semantics: No high-level parameters. The executor supplies two causal observations, oldest first. The observed peg pose is resolved afresh for every decoded action; only the first episode observation may be duplicated for initial padding.
